build_geometry_module: build a GeometryModule to encapsulate UV correspondences and vertex images for a mesh
create_vert_normals: create vertex normals from mesh vertices and face indices using vert_normals_v2
compute_tbn_vectors: compute tangent bitangent and normal vectors from mesh geometry and UV coordinates using compute_tbn
sample_uv_values: sample values from a UV texture map at given UV coordinates using sample_uv
convert_camera_parameters: convert camera Rt and K matrices into campos camrot focal and principal point tensors
